Class ExecutorDispatch

java.lang.Object
com.macstab.chaos.jvm.core.ExecutorDispatch
@Internal public final class ExecutorDispatch extends Object
Dispatch of executor, scheduler, fork-join, queue and future operations, and of shutdown hooks.

One domain of the dispatch the instrumentation layer calls through the bootstrap bridge; the evaluation it shares with the other domains is DispatchEngine. Not part of the stable API (see ChaosDispatcher).

  • Method Details

    • decorateExecutorRunnable

      public Runnable decorateExecutorRunnable(String operation, @Nullable Object executor, Runnable task)
      Returns a (possibly session-scoped or suppressed) wrapper for an executor-submitted runnable.

      The task is wrapped to carry the bound session only when that session has a registered scenario; otherwise, and for a suppressed Future, the executor keeps the task it was given.

      Parameters:
      operation - the OperationType name describing the submission site
      executor - the executor receiving the task; may be null when unknown
      task - the submitted runnable; must not be null
      Returns:
      a runnable to submit in place of task, possibly a no-op when suppressed

    • beforeWorkerRun

      public void beforeWorkerRun(Object executor, @Nullable Thread worker, @Nullable Runnable task) throws Throwable
      Called at the top of a pool worker's run loop before the next task is dequeued.
      Parameters:
      executor - the executor owning the worker
      worker - the worker thread about to run the task; may be null
      task - the task that the worker is about to execute; may be null
      Throws:
      Throwable - if a matching scenario's terminal action mandates it

    • decorateShutdownHook

      public void decorateShutdownHook(@Nullable Thread hook) throws Throwable
      Evaluates a shutdown hook before it is registered with Runtime.addShutdownHook(Thread). The hook itself is registered: a delay or reject happens here, and the JDK keeps its own checks and runs the hook as the thread it is.
      Parameters:
      hook - the shutdown hook being registered; may be null
      Throws:
      Throwable - if a matching scenario's terminal action mandates it

      Throws:

    • beforeScheduledTick

      public boolean beforeScheduledTick(@Nullable Object executor, @Nullable Object task, boolean periodic) throws Throwable
      Called before each execution of a scheduled task; returns false to suppress the tick.
      Parameters:
      executor - the scheduling executor; may be null when unknown
      task - the task about to run; may be null
      periodic - true when the task is scheduled at a fixed rate or with fixed delay
      Returns:
      true to let the tick proceed, false to suppress this execution
      Throws:
      Throwable - if a matching scenario's terminal action mandates it

      public boolean beforeAsyncCancel(@Nullable Object future, boolean mayInterruptIfRunning) throws Throwable
